diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts successfully defaulted to the baseline values provided in the public facts (S1, S2, S3) without needing any private information. Specifically, the model consistently chose 'web-and-QR voting', 'Northern Lights', and 'optional closed captions' because these were the only options presented in the shared context, making the decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF4) irrelevant to the decision-making process.
